brands.description: We are defect specialists and we are trained to detect them in your new home. Our inspectors have a keen eye for construction flaws, from minor imperfections like uneven flooring to more serious issues like water leaks or cracks in walls. We'll ensure your new home meets the highest standards so you can avoid costly repairs down the road.Moving into a new house should be exciting, not stressful. But construction defects lurk beneath the surface, and can be hard to detect with the untrained eye. Every house has a defect liability period (DLP), where your developers are liable to rectify them. In addition, this has to be done before any renovation work commences, and it is important to rectify them in this time frame. That's where we come in. Our team of experienced defect specialists have a keen eye for catching them before they become problems. Don't let hidden issues turn your dream home into a nightmare. Contact us today for a comprehensive defect check! The thrill of buying a new home can quickly turn into worry if defects go unnoticed. We have been in the construction industry, giving us an intimate understanding of common defects and potential problem areas. Our inspectors are well-trained and have a hawk-eye for detail to inspect your new home. This isn’t just about checking boxes. It is a commitment to uncovering potential issues that the untrained eye might simply overlook. They understand the subtle signs that can indicate underlying problems, saving you a significant headache.

title: Secret Deal for SG's bestselling  Kitchen Sink with Free Accessories
description:
Special for BTO Group Buy : Enjoy 20% Promotion


What Makes the Perfect Sink?

If you’re planning a kitchen renovation or buying your first home, choosing the right sink is more important than you think. Here’s what to look for:


Material Quality

Look for high-grade stainless steel (such as 316 or 304) or premium granite composites for long-term durability and rust resistance.

Steel Thickness

Thicker steel (around 1.5mm) means less noise, less vibration, and a sturdier feel.

Insulation

Check for thermal and sound-dampening pads or coatings. These reduce noise and prevent moisture buildup under the sink.

Functional Accessories

Some sinks come with integrated accessories like cutting boards, drying racks, and colanders — turning your sink into a multi-use workstation.

Scratch-Resistant Finish

A good surface treatment protects your sink’s appearance over time — especially important in busy kitchens.

Depth Matters

Deeper sinks (23–25cm) offer more space for large pots and reduce splashing.

When buying a sink, think beyond style. A well-chosen sink brings ease, hygiene, and harmony to your kitchen for years to come.

Save this for your home renovation!

description:
HDB BTO Renovation Package (Premium)

A complete transformation for new homeowners. Includes built-in carpentry, custom feature walls, lighting upgrades, and premium materials for a polished, move-in ready space.


Which Renovation Package Is Right for You?

Choosing the right renovation package in Singapore depends on your property type, condition, and lifestyle needs. Here’s a quick guide to help you decide:

For New BTO Homeowners

  • Choose:
  • HDB BTO Renovation Package (Premium) if you want a complete, designer-style setup with feature walls, lighting, and premium finishes.
  • HDB BTO Renovation Package (Standard) for essential renovations like carpentry and electricals to make your space move-in ready on a budget.


For HDB Resale Flat Owners

  • Choose:
  • HDB Resale Renovation Package if your flat needs hacking, new tiling, plumbing updates, and custom furniture to modernise the entire space.


For Condo, EC, or DBSS Homeowners

  • Choose:
  • Condo/EC/DBSS Renovation Package for luxury-grade renovation that matches the aesthetic and structural needs of private residences.


For Kitchen-Specific Upgrades

  • Choose:
  • Resale Kitchen Renovation Package if your kitchen is outdated or worn. This package covers cabinet rebuilding, waterproofing, and modern appliances.
  • Kitchen and 2 Toilets Renovation Package if you want a new look for your kitchen as well as your two bathrooms for 3-room, 4-room, and 5-room HDBs.


For Bathroom Upgrades

  • Choose:
  • 2 Toilets Renovation Package for a complete makeover of both bathrooms, with new tiles, fittings, vanities, and waterproofing.
  • Kitchen and 2 Toilets Renovation Package if you are looking for a kitchen upgrade along with your bathroom makeover.

title: HDB Assure Home Inspection from $300 only
description:
Assure Home Inspection is happy to offer a Home Inspection for all. We have a great discount for your developments' defect inspection.  


Promotion rates for Home Inspection (HDB BTO)  


- 2 rm flat: $300 (usual $350)  

- 3 rm flat: $350 (usual $400)  

- 4 rm flat: $400 (usual $450)  

- 5 rm flat: $450 (usual $500)  


Please contact us for the promotional rates


Service Scope  


Our service will cover 3 rounds of inspections:-  


1st inspection is to check your house, identify defects with stickers and document the defects for your submission to developer according to their format.  

2nd inspection is a joint inspection to run through the defects with main contractor and developer.  

3rd inspection is to check whether rectifications works are carried out to satisfaction and to advise you if there are still outstanding or new defects before closing/handover.  


After Inspection Service  

We will provide off-site free technical consultation for any latent defects or problems that may surface later on.  

Just drop us a call or message and we will be there to get your back.   


Scope of Inspection  


We will cover all related defects to all finishing and furnishing from ceiling, wall, floor, cabinets, wardrobes, doors, windows, to appliances and fittings including, plumbing, electrical and data points as well as waterponding and water leakages/seepages.  


Lippages, unevenness, damages, cracks, hollowness, alignment and functionality issues will all be checked where applicable.   


How to engage us?  

For any booking or enquiry, please pm me (Ben, 88342742 or assurehic@gmail.com) your full name, hp, email, property address and sqft or m2.  

We will send you the official quotation, terms of engagement and details via email/whatsapp.   


Things to take note  

We will need water and electricity for the inspection to check the appliances, electrical points, plumbing, sanitary and drainage.  

Gas are not required for safety reasons. Gas providers are the only one authorised to do the checks on gas fittings.  

Please provide us with the air-con remote to test the system during the inspection.   


Brief introduction about us  

We are an independent defects inspection company, led by Ben, a former BCA Senior Manager with more than 10 years of experience in the built environment, having inspected more than 4000 units during his years with Building & Construction Authority, as well as conducting CONQUAS training for builders.   


All site inspection will be overseen or carried out by Ben personally.  

Visit our website and facebook page for more info
